title: Why Use Crypto Functions?
description: Understanding when and how to leverage cryptographic capabilities in your data workflows.

sections.title: Data Security & Compliance
sections.description: Modern data systems must handle sensitive information securely. This extension provides enterprise-grade cryptographic primitives directly within DuckDB, eliminating the need to export sensitive data to external systems for encryption or hashing.

bulletPoints.label: Password Storage
bulletPoints.description: Use bcrypt hashing for secure password storage with automatic salt generation and configurable work factors.

bulletPoints.label: PII Protection
bulletPoints.description: Hash or encrypt personally identifiable information (PII) to meet GDPR, CCPA, and HIPAA requirements.

bulletPoints.label: Data Masking
bulletPoints.description: Create consistent, irreversible hashes for data anonymization in analytics and testing environments.

sections.title: Data Integrity & Verification
sections.description: Ensure data hasn't been tampered with by generating cryptographic fingerprints and audit trails. Detect unauthorized modifications and maintain chain-of-custody for critical data.

bulletPoints.label: Blockchain-Style Auditing
bulletPoints.description: Build immutable audit trails using hash chaining to detect any tampering with historical records.

bulletPoints.label: Aggregate Verification
bulletPoints.description: Generate Merkle roots and aggregate hashes to verify entire datasets with a single value.

bulletPoints.label: Checksum Validation
bulletPoints.description: Quickly validate data integrity during ETL pipelines and data transfers.

sections.title: Performance & Scalability
sections.description: Native DuckDB extensions leverage columnar processing and vectorized execution for high-performance cryptographic operations on large datasets without moving data out of the database.

bulletPoints.label: In-Database Processing
bulletPoints.description: Process millions of rows without data serialization or network overhead.

bulletPoints.label: Vectorized Operations
bulletPoints.description: Benefit from DuckDB's SIMD optimizations for batch hashing and encryption.

bulletPoints.label: Zero-Copy Architecture
bulletPoints.description: Avoid expensive data transfers between database and application layers.

useCases.title: Financial Services
useCases.description: Transaction verification, audit trails for compliance, and secure customer data handling.

useCases.title: Healthcare Systems
useCases.description: HIPAA-compliant patient data encryption, secure medical record hashing, and audit logging.

useCases.title: Data Engineering
useCases.description: ETL pipeline checksums, data deduplication via hashing, and secure data lake operations.

useCases.title: SaaS Applications
useCases.description: Multi-tenant data isolation, API key management, and secure password authentication.
